capabilities.rationale: Source-preserving financial observation primitives used by MoneySweep's ingestion, normalization, and accounting-validation pipelines. This module is a deterministic internal data-contract layer, not a standalone human-facing workflow or an analysis surface. It exposes no API, CLI, GUI control, or direct user workflow. Any future user-facing financial lineage, reconciliation, or simulation capability must be separately registered and wired through the complete backend/API/client/GUI/E2E path; this classification does not exempt those future capabilities.
